# True Gain Media

> True Gain Media is an SEO and lead generation agency for businesses in the United Kingdom, the United States and India. It provides local SEO, ecommerce SEO, technical SEO, on-page SEO, content marketing, link building, SEO audits and lead generation, with dedicated pages for industries, sub-categories, cities and city + industry combinations in each country.

The site has about 1251 static pages. URL patterns: /{country}/ (usa, uk, india), /{country}/seo-services-for-{industry}/, /{country}/seo-services-for-{industry}/seo-for-{sub-category}/, /{country}/{city}/ and /{country}/{city}/seo-services-for-{industry}/. Contact: +91 8510813358 (call or WhatsApp), truegainmedia@gmail.com. Free SEO audit available. Language: English.

- [Local SEO Services](https://www.truegainmedia.online/services/local-seo/): Rank in Google Maps and local search to win customers in your city.
- [Ecommerce SEO Services](https://www.truegainmedia.online/services/ecommerce-seo/): Grow organic traffic and sales for your online store.
- [Technical SEO Services](https://www.truegainmedia.online/services/technical-seo/): Fix the crawling, indexing and speed issues that hold rankings back.
- [On-Page SEO & Content Optimization](https://www.truegainmedia.online/services/on-page-seo/): Optimize titles, headings, content and internal links for target keywords.

- [SEO Content Marketing](https://www.truegainmedia.online/services/content-marketing/): Create content that ranks, educates and converts.
